categories.main_business_segments: Nexwise Intelligence China Limited (杰创智能科技股份有限公司) primarily operates in artificial intelligence products and application solutions, AI+ cloud computing products and solutions, AI+ security products and solutions, and industry digital intelligence solutions. The company serves government, public security, energy, industrial, and enterprise customers, focusing on digital transformation and intelligent upgrades across multiple vertical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops core technologies in artificial intelligence, intelligent computing power, and IoT sensing. Key technologies include AI productivity platforms integrating computer vision, NLP, big data, digital twins, cloud computing with virtualization and containerization, high-performance computing hardware integrating GPUs and ASICs, and wireless signal monitoring and analysis. Production methods combine self-processing and outsourced assembly, focusing on software and hardware integration with high-performance computing and AI acceleration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, public security departments, large and medium-sized enterprises in sectors such as finance, education, transportation, energy, and advanced manufacturing. The company also targets markets in Guangdong, Beijing, and expands internationally to Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Belt and Road countries. Major end markets are digital transformation, smart city governance, public safety, and AI infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China, with significant operations in Beijing and over 30 branches nationwide. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and extends its market reach to Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and other international regions under the Belt and Road initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nexwise operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the technology supply chain, focusing on AI product development, system integration, and solution deployment. It provides AI infrastructure products, cloud computing platforms, and intelligent security solutions, serving as a technology provider and system integrator rather than a raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in AI productivity platforms, AI cloud computing, embodied intelligence (robots, drones), and communication security. It invests heavily in AI model development, high-performance computing, wireless signal sensing, and big data analytics. Strategic priorities include accelerating AI product commercialization, expanding AI cloud computing services, enhancing AI security solutions, and pursuing external growth via mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (AI hardware, security devices, cloud computing equipment), solution services (system integration, consulting, software development), and technical services (maintenance, AI application development). The company also explores AI computing power leasing and cloud services as emerging revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic AI and new-generation IT service provider with competitive advantages in AI technology, cloud computing, and security solutions. It competes with other AI infrastructure and smart city solution providers, leveraging its strong R&D, patents, and government/enterprise customer base. It faces intensified competition from both platform-based AI giants and specialized vertical AI firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 644 million, a 24.47% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 80 million. R&D investment remains robust at over 11% of revenue. The company is in a strategic transformation phase, focusing on AI product and solution commercialization, with growth expected in AI cloud computing and security segments despite recent profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nexwise emphasizes high-performance, cost-effective AI computing infrastructure and intelligent security products integrating AI, robotics, and electromagnetic technologies. Its AI productivity platform supports rapid AI application development with extensive industry-specific datasets and models. The company differentiates through proprietary technologies in AI, intelligent computing, and IoT sensing, combined with strong integration capabilities and tailored solutions for government and enterprise digital transformation.
